notes: DECISION: two official rasters of the Z-and-dot mark exist and each has a cost. (1) Shipped: the Zenoti Mobile business app's icon, 1024px, white tile, reads on both themes, but the Z is small inside a decorative ring of dots and in the app's teal and red. (2) zenoti.com's own apple-touch icon (downloads/zenoti/s2-1/apple-icon.png, 180px): the corporate Z and dot in #333638 on transparent, closest to the current brand, but it vanishes on the dark theme and Zenoti publishes no white version of the Z (/zenoti-logo-white.svg exists only for the wordmark). Pick (2) only if a near-invisible dark-theme icon is acceptable. No SVG qualifies: every Zenoti vector is the 'zenoti' wordmark (zenoti-logo.svg, the current file, whose dark grey vanishes on dark; zenoti-logo-white.svg; help.zenoti.com's portal-logo.svg), and the Z-and-dot is a separate drawing (the wordmark's dot belongs to its 'i').
license: Zenoti brand mark, used nominatively to identify the connected service; trademark rights remain with Zenoti.
